The orc shamans use poisoned equipment in their rituals. You go down through the Edron Orc Cave, cross four floors full of orcs and {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and open the chest at the bottom, which has a backpack with 2 {item:Poison Dagger|Poison Daggers} and 30 {item:Poison Arrow|Poison Arrows}.
Edron Orc Cave entrance, southwest of the castle

If you are not in **Edron**, take a boat: talk to the harbour captain in your city (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the Edron harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.
